title: They Trapped Him In A Dark Parking Garage . . . And The Wrong Boy Walked In (highlight)
caption:
In Weak Hero Class 1, episode 6, Sam walks into a dark parking garage alone, and Bobby's whole gang is waiting. Full recap is on our page 👉 link in the comments

#weakhero #kdrama #kdramarecap #recap #spoilerroom

segments.say: Sam walks alone into a dark parking garage, and Amy is already *there*.
It started at Max's birthday party, with balloons, pizza, and a missing *guest*.
Amy slipped out to meet Bobby at a cafe, all alone, and soon her phone went *dead*.
Then a picture of Amy popped up on a phone, with an *address*.
Sam told everyone he was going to the shop, and walked out *alone*.
In the garage, Bobby was grilling Amy. Are you dating *Max*?
Then a boy walked in, and it was not *Max*.
Amy shoved Sam toward the stairs. You go first. I'll get the *police*.
Sam grabbed a pipe, and for a minute he actually *won*.
Then Wolf strolled in, and he was not *impressed*.

segments.text: I said let him go. I only need Su-ho.

segments.say: The gang circles Sam. And he is all out of *tricks*.
